changelog:
WHAT'S NEW
Plex opens faster: Home shows the moment Continue Watching and Recently Added land, posters fill in behind, and every rail asks the server for only the fields it shows.
Plex on small boxes: Home's per-library queries run two at a time instead of all at once, rails are shorter, and a server that does not answer in ten seconds shows an empty row instead of holding the screen.
Nothing adult on the home screen: the content bar and Plex Home, Discover and Search skip adult channels, categories, libraries and titles. An adult Plex library keeps its own tab.

FIXES
Plex: the library list is fetched once on connect, not twice.
releaseNotes: Version 1.7.6 makes Plex open faster and lighter on small boxes, and keeps adult content off the content bar and the Plex Home, Discover and Search rails. Installs normally over 1.7.5.
